body:
Hi @JugglerX,

Thank you for raising this issue.

This is due to having the same instance of `InstantSearch` across two different pages, as it's declared in `_app.tsx` so it wraps the page.

You can circumvent this by adding a `key` to `InstantSearch`, so that there is a dedicated instance per page. You could add this to [your `Default.tsx` file, line 93](https://github.com/JugglerX/bal-router/blob/52703050bb2163dfbdcb7b10063201bc4953b56d/src/layouts/Default.tsx#L93) :

```js
key={router.pathname}
```
